notes.title: Demo v0.7.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
New Content

 Added Rocket Launcher Soldier and Combat Drone enemy types
 Introduced new map: "Research Outpost"


UI Improvements

 Implemented radar UI system to track and locate nearby enemies


Bug Fixes & Optimizations

 Various performance improvements
 Fixed several crash issues reported by the community


We appreciate your continued support! Join our Discord to share your feedback!

notes.title: Demo v0.6.12 Patch Notes
notes.content:
New Features

Item Progression System

 Added unlock requirements for most of the items
 New notification system shows when items are unlocked

UI & Controls

 Redesigned Orbital Support interface for improved usability and visibilty
Added power management hotkeys:
[olist]
 Zero Power: Instantly cut power to all systems
 Minimum Power: Set all systems to minimum required power
 Excess Power: Distribute all available power to active systems
[/olist]
Stats & Tracking

 Implemented comprehensive stat tracking system
 Track your combat performance, item usage, and progression metrics


Major Overhauls

Equipment Rebalance

 Reworked Relics, Consumables and other parts for better gameplay balance

Visual Improvements

 Updated scene lighting for improved visibility and atmosphere
 Enhanced visual feedback for power management systems


Bug Fixes

 Fixed multiple issues with power distribution systems
 Resolved UI inconsistencies in the equipment screens
 Corrected various minor gameplay bugs


We appreciate your continued support during Early Access. Join our Discord to share your feedback on these changes!

notes.title: Demo v0.5.23 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Gameplay Updates
Implemented new vehicle selection system featuring four unique mechs:

 Pathfinder: Balanced all-rounder
 Bulwark: Heavy defense specialist
 Interceptor: High-mobility scout
 Reaper: High-risk, high-reward striker


Combat & Systems

 Added numerous new relics to expand build variety and strategic options
 Rebalanced relic stat calculations for better gameplay consistency
 Adjusted item prices across all shops for improved economy balance
 Fixed items purchased from orbital shop lose their power values and cannot be modified after equipping


User Interface

 Enhanced main menu and settings menu with improved focus system
 Fixed shop UI not properly pausing the game during transactions
 Resolved various cases of input lockup during gameplay


We're testing for any new issues with the vehicle selection system
Please report any bugs or feedback on our Discord server
